crossRefs.note: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.
If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden…
crossRefs.keyword: make, etc. or, set them as a butt

crossRefs.note: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up…
crossRefs.keyword: make, etc. or, set them as a butt

crossRefs.note: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
crossRefs.keyword: make, etc. or, set them as a butt

crossRefs.note: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
crossRefs.keyword: make, etc. or, set them as a butt

crossRefs.note: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

translations.web: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
translations.bsb: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
translations.kjv: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face
translations.asv: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.
